name: 17kv antipersonnel twin blaster
description: The 17kv antipersonnel twin blaster was a type of twin blaster cannon equipped onto the Multi-Troop Transports of the Trade Federation and its private droid army. Following the outbreak of the Clone Wars, in which the Multi-Troop Transport found its way into the droid armies of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the 17kv antipersonnel twin blaster was used by the Confederacy during the war.
